full_judgment: 8. There is no dispute that both the parties are heirs of Imam Bux and the plaintiffs are claiming title as heirs of Wazuddin, son of Syed Ali and on the other hand, the defendants are claiming title and heirs of Abdul Majid, son of Sayed Ali. Admittedly Imam Bux died leaving widow Pathani Bibi, son Sayed Ali, daughters Elemjan and Halimon. Pathani Bibi subsequently died leaving her son and daughter. Therefore, admittedly Syed Ali inherited 8 annas share and Elemjan and Halimon inherited 4 annas share each in the suit land. There is also no dispute that Sayed Ali, Elemjan and Halimon amicably partitioned schedule 'Ka' land and as per partition, Elemjan and Halimon got 'Kha' schedule land and Sayed Ali got 'Ga' schedule land. Admittedly Elemjan and Halimon were dispossessed by the heirs of Sayed Ali and in Title Suit No. 1225 of 1922 they got possession though Court, which is evident from exhibit-3 series. The learned Subordinate Judge observed that though in Money Execution Case Nos. 110 and 111 of 1952 the defendant No. 2 Atikullah and his mother Siratunnessa purchased 0.20 acre in plot No. 76, 0.89 in plot No. 27 and 0.64 acres in plot No. 29 in auction, the parties had amicably compromised the matter and in pursuance of such compromise, sale in respect of only 0.07 acre of land in plot No. 27 in Money Execution Case No. 111 of 1952 and 0.20 acre of land in plot No. 76 of Khatian No. 40 relating to 'Gha' schedule land in Money Execution Case No. 110 of 1952 were confirmed, and that the auction sale in respect of other land was set aside.
